resolve: export CLICOLOR_FORCE=0 NO_COLOR=1; ref=$(printf %s "$FACTORY_INPUT" | sed -e "s/^[[:space:]]*//" -e "s/[[:space:]]*$//"); n=$(printf %s "$ref" | sed -n -e "s|^#\{0,1\}\([1-9][0-9]*\)$|\1|p" -e "s|^https://github.com/jasoncarreira/opencode-feature-factory/issues/\([1-9][0-9]*\)$|\1|p"); [ -n "$n" ] || exit 0; gh issue view "$n" --repo jasoncarreira/opencode-feature-factory --json number,title,body,url,state,labels,assignees --jq '{run_id:(.number|tostring)} + .'
